contentCn:
来，照照小镜子——你看见谁啦？是你呀！

看看你的脸：有两颗亮亮的小眼睛，一个鼻子，一张小嘴巴。还有眉毛和睫毛，像小刷子一样，帮眼睛挡住灰尘，不让灰灰跑进去。

再凑近看眼睛里，有没有一个彩色的小圆圈？那是虹膜哦。你的虹膜是什么颜色呀？

看看鼻子，上面有两个小洞洞，叫鼻孔。香味、饭香、花香，都是从这里跑进去，让你闻到的。

鼻子下面是嘴巴，可以用它吃饭、喝水、呼呼、说话：“妈妈好！”“我喜欢你！”

头两边还有耳朵，“叮咚叮咚”，声音被耳朵接住，你就听到唱歌和说话啦。

大家的脸都有眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、耳朵，可是你的眼睛、你的鼻子、你的嘴巴、你的耳朵，大小形状都是你的。合起来——哇，就是独一无二的你！
contentEn:
Come, look in the little mirror — who do you see? It's you!

Look at your face: two bright little eyes, a nose, a small mouth. And eyebrows and eyelashes, like little brushes, helping your eyes block dust.

Look closer into your eyes. Do you see a colorful little circle? That's your iris. What color is your iris?

Look at your nose. There are two little holes called nostrils. The smell of food, flowers, and perfume all go in through here so you can sniff them.

Below your nose is your mouth. You can eat, drink, blow, and talk with it: "Hi Mom!" "I like you!"

On the sides of your head are your ears. "Ding dong ding dong" — sounds are caught by your ears, and you hear singing and talking.

Everyone has eyes, a nose, a mouth, and ears. But your eyes, your nose, your mouth, your ears — their size and shape are all yours. Put them together — wow, you are one of a kind!
